requirements.title: Bachelors degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or related field
requirements.description: Candidate must have a relevant educational background.
requirements.explanation: Nitin Mishra holds a B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering from Government Engineering College, Rewa.

requirements.title: Basic familiarity with at least one programming language (C or Python)
requirements.description: Candidate should be familiar with programming for scripting tests.
requirements.explanation: Nitin is proficient in both C and Python, as listed under his skills.

requirements.title: Interest in embedded systems, hardware debugging, and QA processes
requirements.description: Candidate should show an interest or have experience in embedded systems and QA.
requirements.explanation: There is no evidence in Nitin's CV that indicates an interest or experience in embedded systems or QA processes.

requirements.title: Good analytical skills and a detail-oriented approach to documentation
requirements.description: Candidate should possess strong analytical and documentation skills.
requirements.explanation: Nitin has demonstrated analytical skills in his projects, but there is no specific evidence of his documentation skills.

requirements.title: Ability to work in a lab environment with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related tools
requirements.description: Candidate should be able to operate common lab equipment.
requirements.explanation: There is no mention of experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or similar lab equipment in Nitin's CV.

wishes.title: Exposure to serial communication protocols (UART, SPI, I²C)
wishes.description: It is preferable if the candidate has knowledge of serial communication protocols.
wishes.explanation: Nitin's CV does not mention any experience with UART, SPI, or I²C protocols.

wishes.title: Understanding of version control systems (e.g., Git)
wishes.description: Candidate should have experience with version control systems.
wishes.explanation: Nitin has experience with Git and GitHub, as mentioned in his skills section.

wishes.title: Prior internship or coursework in embedded or hardware-related projects
wishes.description: Experience in embedded systems or hardware-related projects is preferred.
wishes.explanation: There is no evidence of internships or coursework specifically related to embedded systems or hardware in Nitin's CV.
